title: Generate architecture snapshots within safe output boundaries
statement: The system shall generate a selected architecture snapshot without modifying engineering sources, unrelated files or a prior readable snapshot on rejected or failed generation, and shall report truthful output and recovery outcomes.

what.problem: Generation may corrupt prior output, change sources or disclose unrelated information.
what.desired_outcome: generate a selected architecture snapshot without modifying engineering sources, unrelated files or a prior readable snapshot on rejected or failed generation, and shall report truthful output and recovery outcomes.

why.rationale: Customer use needs attributable, portable views and truthful boundaries beyond repository-local demonstration.

conditions: When generating, reading or qualifying the selected architecture browser capability.

contexts: One selected customer project/state and explicitly selected output; declared product generation and reading environments.

how.approach: Assess the stated observable outcomes against explicit supported profiles, selected source identity and actual artifacts; preserve ownership and diagnose unavailable or incomplete results.

how_much.scope: Read-only local generation and portable snapshot reading. No live editor, hosted-service requirement, cross-project aggregation, automatic publication or invented performance target. Detailed realization and platform support are downstream design decisions.

acceptance_criteria: Reject an output selection overlapping authoritative input or requiring replacement of unrelated files before mutation; replacement is confined to explicitly selected generated output.

For invalid input, rendering failure or interrupted generation, preserve the prior complete readable snapshot or restore it through the declared recovery procedure before reporting successful replacement; an unresolved partial state is reported and never called complete.
Generation leaves canonical model bytes unchanged and includes only selected model content and necessary reading resources, excluding unrelated workspace content and private operational history.
Hostile text, links and paths cannot execute supplied script, escape the selected output boundary or cause undeclared resource acquisition.
Generation and reading do not publish or upload content. Publication requires a separate explicit action and applicable authority.
Equivalent declared inputs and tool versions produce equivalent declared snapshot content; actual provenance observations are identified separately from deterministic content.

sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
